item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:10 HKT 03/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over southern China this week. Tropical Cyclone Nalgae will edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary today. Under the influence of its outer rainbands, there will still be occasional showers today. With Nalgae weakening and dissipating, the weather is expected to improve and showers will ease off gradually over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the following couple of days.

Date/Month: 03/11 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 7 to 8, occasionally force 9 on high ground at first, becoming east to northeast force 5 to 6 later.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional squally showers. Showers will be heavy at times at first and will ease off gradually during the day. Seas will be very rough with swells.
Temp range: 19 - 24 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
